plan: The most important thing is playing soothing shore or altaria will kill suicune with their attack. Inflatable boat can be played, but I wouldn't on this turn. Their bench is full so team rocket's boss is pointless and if their bench wasn't full, then you would play it to do more damage, their bench affects their damage so they would likely play onto their bench next turn anyway. Attach energy to suicune and attack.
text: Play Soothing Shore (Stadium): At the end of each player's turn, that player heals 20 damage from each of their Pokémon that has any Water Energy attached.
